//: Lighthouse CI, asserting the design's Core Web Vitals table on mobile.
Two tiers, because the design states two: a target and a hard fail. The target is a `warn`
so a regression is visible in the CI log the day it lands; the hard fail is an `error` so a
build that crosses it does not deploy.
| Metric | target (warn) | hard fail (error) |
| TBT | 150 ms | 250 ms |
| TTFB (server-response-time) | 200 ms | 500 ms |
| Performance | 0.95 | 0.90 |
| Accessibility | 1.0 | 0.95 |
| Best Practices | 0.95 | 0.95 |
INP has no lab audit — it is a field metric, measured from real interactions. Lighthouse's
closest lab proxies are Total Blocking Time and `max-potential-fid`, so both are asserted
rather than pretending an INP number was measured here. The 150 ms / 200 ms INP row of the
design's table is therefore enforced by the TBT and max-potential-FID assertions below plus
field data once the site has traffic; claiming otherwise would be a number with nothing
behind it.
The four URLs are the four route shapes the budget table distinguishes: the homepage, the
collection, a product detail page, and a static content page. `/product/...` is only
assertable once a product content file exists; until then the run covers the other three and
the PDP entry is the first thing to add with the first product.
Requirements: 22.1, 22.2, 22.3, 22.14. Design: Performance Budgets → Core Web Vitals targets.
